title: AutoFlow: Auto Clicker & Macro
shortDescription: Auto clicker, macros and routines with a one-tap Stop. Local-first, no ads.
fullDescription:
AutoFlow is an auto clicker, macro maker and routine builder for everything you repeat on your phone. Set up a simple auto clicker in seconds in Easy mode, or build complete macros with variables, conditions and loops in Pro mode.

WHAT YOU CAN AUTOMATE
• Taps, double taps, long presses and swipes at the exact spots you pick
• Typing into text fields, plus Back, Home, Recents and other system actions
• Waits, repeats, if/else, lists and variables
• Notifications, opening apps and links, simple website checks
• Triggers: a schedule, charging, Wi-Fi, headphones, a hardware-keyboard shortcut or an app coming to the front

SAFE BY DESIGN
• A floating Stop button and a Stop action in the notification whenever a flow runs
• Every flow has limits for run time, actions and repeats, plus a start countdown
• A safety score and the permissions a flow needs are shown before it runs
• AutoFlow never acts on the lock screen, permission dialogs or system Settings

TEMPLATES
Start from ready-made flows: auto clicker, feed swiper, break reminder, form filler, charging night routine and more — then change anything you like.

HOW AUTOFLOW USES THE ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE
AutoFlow uses Android's Accessibility Service API only to perform the taps, swipes, typing and system actions in the flows you create and start, and to show the floating Stop button. It does not collect, store or share what is on your screen. You turn the service on yourself in Settings › Accessibility after AutoFlow explains exactly what it does, and you can turn it off at any time.

PRIVACY
• Local-first: flows are stored on your device and work without an account
• No ads and no advertising ID
• We never sell your data
• Optional account sync is end-to-end encrypted — the server only keeps encrypted data
• Privacy policy: https://autoflow-651.pages.dev/en/privacy/

AutoFlow does not bypass CAPTCHAs, security checks or anti-cheat systems. Please follow the rules of the apps and games you automate.

Also available on Windows and in your browser: https://autoflow-651.pages.dev
